# Draft:La Veine Verte: La Renaissance Agroecologique de l' Afrique d'Ouest (2023)

This movie is a documentary from Mali, Burkina Faso, Ghana, Benin and Nigeria and directed by Sara De Sousa Correia and produced by Fernando Naves Sousa.
Plot
This movie is about a new power emerging in the fields, classrooms and urban gardens of West Africa. Sprouting in every corner of the region, seeds are flourishing in the hands of innovative farmers, young entrepreneurs, and visionaries.
